title: Normalize tool schema format enums and structured-format contract
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.7. format enums and parser acceptance are inconsistent (json-v2/envelope/json variants). Align schema declarations with runtime parser support and add contract tests for all supported values.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Normalized search-tool format contract declarations in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` so schema enums match runtime parser support (`markdown`, `json`, `envelope`, `json-v2`) and updated format descriptions to call out compatibility aliases explicitly. Added focused contract tests in `MemorySmith.Tests/ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.cs`: `SearchToolSchemas_AdvertiseAllStructuredFormatAliases` and `SearchTool_AcceptsStructuredFormatAliases` (json/envelope/json-v2). Also hardened `MemorySmith.Tests/McpAndSemanticSearchTests.cs` retrieval-envelope test with explicit `MemorySmith:Mcp:MaxToolResponseCharacters=50000` override so format-contract assertions are not confounded by MCP payload capping. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~SearchToolSchemas_AdvertiseAllStructuredFormatAliases|Name~SearchTool_AcceptsStructuredFormatAliases|Name~SearchTool_WithJsonFormat_ReturnsEnvelopeAndContextDiagnostics|Name~McpSearchTool_WithJsonFormat_ReturnsRetrievalEnvelope"` (6/6 passed). Live check: `Invoke-WebRequest https://localhost:7090/health -SkipCertificateCheck` returned `200`.
